variant: dam construction fleet (dump trucks, bulldozers, vibratory rollers)
name: Kajima A4CSEL
specialisedFor: dam embankment construction: hauling, spreading and compaction
summary: Kajima's in-house system that runs fleets of self-driving dump trucks, bulldozers and vibratory rollers to build dam embankments, supervised from a distant control room.

germany.statusNote: Not a product for sale: A4CSEL is Kajima's in-house construction system, run by Kajima on its own projects in Japan. No sale, licence or use outside Japan found.

specs.label: Automated machines
specs.value: vibratory rollers, bulldozers and rigid dump trucks

specs.label: Added for land development
specs.value: automated backhoe and articulated dump truck
specs.conditions: land-development sites, with the bulldozer and roller

specs.label: Base machines
specs.value: general-purpose construction machines modified for automation

specs.label: Fleet size
specs.value: more than ten automated machines of three types

specs.label: Supervision
specs.value: three IT pilots in a control room 400 km away
specs.conditions: Naruse Dam fleet, run from Kajima's Seisho Experimental Field

specs.label: Continuous operation
specs.conditions: at peak, over three days and nights, stopping only to refuel

specs.label: Fuel saving
specs.conditions: fuel per m³ of spreading by an autonomous bulldozer versus a manned one, maker measurement

specs.label: People in work area
specs.value: nobody may enter the automated construction area

notes: A fleet system, not a single machine: Kajima converts standard machines and plans their work centrally with AI and simulation.
People are kept out of the automated area; IT pilots supervise from a remote control room.

images.alt: Automated dump truck unloading CSG while an automated bulldozer waits at Naruse Dam

evidence.task: First automatic vibratory rollers on a dam site
More than ten automated dump trucks, bulldozers and vibratory rollers place the CSG embankment day and night
evidence.where: Naruse Dam, Higashinaruse village, Akita Prefecture, Japan
evidence.note: Embankment of 4.85 million m³; in May 2022 about twice the previous record monthly volume in Japan was placed.

evidence.task: Automated bulldozers build an erosion-control weir in a disaster area where people may not enter during the rainy season
evidence.where: No. 3 Erosion Control Weir, Akadani district, Kii Peninsula, Japan
evidence.note: Same or higher efficiency than manned work according to Kajima; date is when the site was part of Kajima's central-control test.

evidence.task: Twenty automated machines at three sites controlled centrally by four IT pilots from Kajima's Tokyo head office
Two automated vibrating rollers compact fill on a land-development site with a complex shape
evidence.where: Achiwa District Industrial Park Development Project, Okazaki City, Japan
evidence.note: First use of A4CSEL on land development (fiscal 2024).
